description: This file implements the <log> element for the MiniLang framework in Apache OFBiz. It defines a Log class that handles logging at various levels, utilizing attributes 'level' and 'message', and contains internal validation, execution logic, and a factory for instantiation.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Represents a logging operation in the MiniLang framework, supporting different log levels and message expansion.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Log object by parsing the XML element attributes and setting up the message expander and log level.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the logging operation if the debug level is enabled, expanding the message and outputting it with contextual information.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Log object, including level and message.
